heading: Siting to temporary building
content:
52.
Siting to temporary building
(1)
No temporary building constructed of readily combustible materials shall be erected within 3 m of—
(a)
any other building; or
(b)
the boundary of the site within which it is located.
(2)
Such space of 3 m shall be kept clear.
(L.N. 294 of 1976)
